title: Two new coplanar tetranuclear lanthanide complexes (Ln = Gd(III) and Dy(III)) with magnetic refrigeration and slow magnetic relaxation behaviors

synthesis.procedure: Complexes 1 and 2 were prepared by the same procedure. HL (0.02 mmol) was dissolved in acetonitrile (10 mL) and dichloromethane (10 mL), then two equivalents of Ln(tmhd) (Ln = Gd for 1) were added. The mixture was stirred vigorously for 3 h at ambient temperature, filtered, and the filtrate was left undisturbed. After eight days, evaporation of the mother liquor afforded red block-shaped crystals of 1 (yield 36% based on Gd).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, and slow evaporation/volatilization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After filtration, the solution was kept undisturbed; evaporation of the mother liquor over eight days gave red block-shaped crystals.

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility (1000 Oe, 2–300 K) gives χMT = 30.97 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature, decreasing to 13.16 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Curie–Weiss fit: C = 30.86 cm3 K mol−1, θ = −5.75 K, indicating antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization saturates at 29.25 Nβ (2 K, 8 T). Cryogenic magnetocaloric effect: −ΔSm,max = 21.13 J kg−1 K−1 at 2.5 K and ΔH = 7.0 T (theoretical 23.39 J kg−1 K−1 for 4R ln(2S+1)).

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1: HL (0.02 mmol) was dissolved in acetonitrile (10 mL) and dichloromethane (10 mL), then two equivalents of Dy(tmhd) were added. After vigorous stirring for 3 h at ambient temperature and filtration, the solution was left undisturbed. Red block-shaped crystals formed after eight days by evaporation of the mother liquor (yield 41% based on Dy).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, and slow evaporation/volatilization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After filtration, the solution was kept undisturbed; evaporation of the mother liquor over eight days gave red block-shaped crystals.

properties.summary: χMT = 56.46 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature (1000 Oe), falling to 31.45 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Curie–Weiss: C = 55.62 cm3 K mol−1, θ = −2.88 K (antiferromagnetic interactions). Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility is frequency-dependent with χ″ peaks, indicating slow magnetic relaxation/SMM behavior. Cole–Cole α = 0.35–0.50 (2–16 K). Arrhenius fit (8–12 K) gives ΔE/kB = 67.8 K and τ0 = 1.82 × 10−7 s; a low-T temperature-independent regime is attributed to QTM.
